text:
alex: Customer MaplePay reports streaming responses missing the final chunk after a client reconnect. Happens after ~3m idle; they see truncated JSON and then client retries. request_id=req_0a2b3c region=us-west-2 model=gpt-small origin=cloudfront->alb. They provided a pcap and ALB access log.

maria: Do we have the client's request example and headers? curious about Connection/Keep-Alive and cookies.

alex: curl they used:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Cookie: session=abc123; path=/; HttpOnly" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=gpt-small
```
They say if they wait ~3 minutes then reconnect, the first event stream is partial (missing last event).

kevin: pinging @eng-oncall. Quick hypothesis: ALB idle timeout (60s default) + CloudFront TCP connection reuse + sticky cookie means client reconnects get a different connection/midstream half-close. Need ALB/CF logs and a packet capture to confirm FIN behavior.

support-lead: Escalating. @kevin can you take this? customer is on paid Dedicated beta so SLA applies.

eng-oncall-bot: oncall assigned -> kevin

kevin: I reviewed the pcap and ALB access logs. Sequence: origin sends final chunk and closes. ALB then sends FIN to client before the last TCP ACK is fully propagated when CloudFront reuses the connection. PCAP shows: origin -> ALB: chunked data with final CRLF, ALB -> CF: FIN right after, CF -> client: connection reset on reuse. Server app logs show complete response wrote out. So root looks like proxy handoff and idle-probe + connection reuse race.

maria: Can you paste a trimmed pcap log snippet?

kevin: Snippet: 
```
[TCP] origin -> ALB: PUSH data (final chunk) seq=12345 len=512
[TCP] ALB -> CF: ACK
[TCP] ALB -> CF: FIN
[TCP] CF -> client: RST (on reuse)
```
App log around same time: "wrote 512 bytes, flush ok" then later: "write error: broken pipe"

alex: Customer also worried about duplicate billing tokens when clients reconnect — they saw token usage count spike when retrying mid-stream.

kevin: Duplicate tokens likely from client retrying the request (client-side retry + reconnect). Streaming requests aren't currently deduped server-side. Short-term: ask customer to avoid automatic full-retry on reconnect (retry only on explicit error), or include idempotency/request_id and we can dedupe.

maria: Workarounds we recommend to customer:
- enable TCP keepalive / reduce idle time between CF and ALB (CloudFront idle > origin),
- set ALB idle timeout > expected client idle (e.g., 300s) or switch to NLB for passthrough,
- send small heartbeat bytes from client every 15-30s (e.g., ":\\n\n") to prevent idle close,
- avoid sticky session cookie reuse across long idle periods if using CF with origin connection pooling.

maria: Example minimal heartbeat for JS client: `ws/stream` style: send `\n` every 20s or server can send a zero-width event `:heartbeat\n\n`. For node fetch stream: `setInterval(() => controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode('\n')) , 20000)`

kevin: For our infra follow-up: 1) check ALB idle settings for this customer (they use marketplace connector), 2) see if CloudFront origin keepalive config is defaulting low, 3) add server-side dedupe by request_id for streaming start events to avoid double charge when client retries immediately.

support-lead: Creating case S-2098 and engineering ticket INF-842 to track dedupe + docs update. Customer agreed to try heartbeat client-side and bump ALB idle to 300s for now.

alex: Customer applied heartbeat and reported no truncations in 2 test runs. They will monitor in prod for 24h. They also want a follow-up meeting to discuss billing dedupe.

kevin: I'll own INF-842. Quick note for runbook: if truncated-first-chunk after idle and origin logs show full flush, look for proxy FIN/RST ordering and CloudFront connection reuse. Recommended triage commands: `tcptrace`/`tcpdump -w` + ALB access logs correlation by request_id.

maria: Adding KB snippet for support: short checklist and sample heartbeat code. I'll update internal docs after INF-842 lands. :memo:

support-lead: Thanks team. Marking resolved for now pending customer 24h confirmation. :white_check_mark:
